product_one_liner.value: HealthData Platform is a cloud-hosted data-management platform for healthcare organizations to extract, migrate, archive, and manage patient, employee, and business records.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its work as extracting, migrating, and archiving data, and its platform as cloud-hosted infrastructure securing patient, employee, and business records for healthcare delivery organizations.

pricing_page.notes: The official site has a page titled Pricing and explains how its archiving, service, licensing, and hosting solutions are priced, with budgetary pricing available by contact.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Harmony Healthcare IT case-study pages identify Magnolia Regional Health Center and Parkview Health as organizations that selected or contracted with the company. | named_customers.0: The case study names Magnolia Regional Health Center and describes its selection of Harmony Healthcare IT. | named_customers.1: The case study says Parkview contracted with Harmony Healthcare IT.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile reports 235 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The portfolio profile lists the headquarters in South Bend, Indiana; the city value is South Bend. | hq_country: The portfolio profile identifies the headquarters as South Bend, Indiana, and explicitly describes the company as headquartered there in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company announcement states that Harmony Healthcare IT was founded in 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The technical category index and its representative article titles concern migration best practices and data-management steps, rather than how the product is built. The inspected index did not establish at least two engineer-authored architecture, infrastructure, ML, data-systems, incident, or open-source posts.

public_docs.notes: The publicly accessible company resource page contains multiple detailed product tutorials, including Conversion, DR Dashboard, DR Auditor, and OpenGate tutorials, which qualify as public product documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists six openings, and none of the listed job titles contains AI, ML, machine learning, data science, applied scientist, research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer vision.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company Trust Center lists SOC 2 and HIPAA among compliance items. Of the five requested names, these are the ones it names; HITRUST R2 and PIPEDA are outside the requested list. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is explicitly listed on the Trust Center compliance page. | compliance_certs.1: HIPAA is explicitly listed on the Trust Center compliance page.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding database identifies the latest round type as Private Equity - II. | funding_date: The funding profile calls the November 28, 2023 Private Equity - II round the latest funding round; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2023-11. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile identifies the latest round and its date, but the amount cell is blank, so the amount of this round is not publicly established in the cited record.

raised_18mo.notes: The database identifies November 28, 2023 as the latest funding round, before the 18-month window beginning May 9, 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board has Associate Business Development Director and Business Development Director roles, but neither title is SDR, BDR, business development representative, sales representative, or account executive; the other openings also do not match those titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The identified product-launch announcement is the ClearWay launch from February 2025, before the six-month window. More recent inspected company announcements include a 20-year milestone and a Carahsoft partnership, not a product or major-feature launch; no qualifying launch within the window was found. The newer Harmony Ignite product information did not itself identify a dated launch announcement.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company announced Brian Liddell as CEO effective April 30, 2026, succeeding Tom Liddell, within the 12 months before the specified date.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The visible technology-stack listing names Drift and HubSpot, identifying Drift as live chat and HubSpot as marketing automation, and also includes Simpli.fi in the stack. These are the listed sales/marketing-related systems; unrelated infrastructure and other stack items are excluded. | crm_stack_signal.0: The listed stack names HubSpot and labels it Marketing Automation. | crm_stack_signal.1: The listed stack names Drift and labels it Live Chat. | crm_stack_signal.2: Simpli.fi appears by name in the company technology-stack listing and is included as a marketing-related advertising technology.
